title: Promenade
description:
In Promenade you have to collect golden cogs to fix the great elevator and unlock new worlds.

To do so, you can engage with a bunch of diverse activities, like puzzles, races, cute NPCs, and many secrets scattered everywhere by using a dynamic moveset.

Whether you like puzzles that require lateral thinking, technical platforming, or just wandering around, there's always something interesting awaiting for you around the corner.

Use object's properties to your advantage : double jump by throwing an object down, glide when holding a chicken, run at insane speed with the rocket and a lot more to experiment !

And since you only need to collect some of the cogs to progress, you can follow your instinct and only engage with what interests you the most.
Will it be platforming challenges ? Interacting with colorful characters ? Or facing the bosses that dwell in dungeons ?

Wether you're a completionist, a cozy gamer, a speedrunner or a collectathon lover, you'll find your way to finish the game the way you like !
description_short: Go on an adventure in a world packed with secrets helped by your friend, a poulp with many abilities. Explore, solve puzzles, wander across dungeons, blast through races and much more in this cute game inspired by the best 3D platformers
